_comment: NOTE: no `回复 ok` instruction here — see the warning in review_roundN.json; `ok` in DEV_TRIAGE is either dropped or read as an approver approval. Round 1 review post, self-service dev loop (DESIGN §1.23) — @DEVELOPER triages the issue list; the approver is only mentioned once the dev replies `done` (handoff_summary, §1.23.7). Simple reviews pass FILES + ISSUES (full inline detail); full/complex reviews pass DOC_LINK + ISSUES (terse) and OMIT FILES. No escalate line here — escalation is the approver's, post-handoff. Keep the reply-instruction lines in sync with review_roundN.json.

content.text: 请先确认需要修复的问题:
· 回复问题序号（如 1 3 5）确认修复这些问题，其余视为有异议
· 回复 "-2" 表示仅对 #2 有异议，其余修复；回复 "all" 全部修复
· 回复 "none" 或 "不修" 表示全部有异议
· 序号后可附异议理由（如 "-2 该写法是有意为之"），提交终审时一并转交审查人
· 回复 "done" 提交审查人终审
